Descriptif du poste

Commodity COST ANALYST is highly responsible & trusted profession, it involves following contribution to the organisation.

  • Control the cost and optimize the technical specifications of the parts in the commodity
  • Develop, create & update particular commodity’s techno economical database for the costing tools.
  • Sustain & develop a good level of cross functional and cultural relationship with all customers.
